players.product: active electrical cable (AEC) manufacturing and high-speed / power cable assemblies

quarterly_data.signal: BizLink and its wholly owned subsidiary BizLink Speedy Pte. Ltd. jointly completed the acquisition of the Interplex group's Datacom Business, which is consolidated into BizLink's financial statements from September 23, 2026. The company says the deal adds customized interconnect solutions, high-precision mechanical products and related manufacturing capability, and that the precision metal processing technology is critical to supporting its Equipment Solutions business unit (used in semiconductor cabinets, medical equipment and system integration assembly) and other applications.
